## Introduction

This benchmark finds how many concurrent particles it takes to saturate the GPU on the S&P 500 (SPX) stochastic volatility model [@sun2024]. The number of particles in flight during IF2 is $J \times \text{chains}$. We grow it two ways: by raising $J$ at a fixed number of chains, and by adding chains at a fixed $J$.

Iteration counts are kept small on purpose. Each grid point runs `mif` twice with the same $M$. The first call pays for JIT compilation, and the second is timed to give the steady-state cost per iteration. The key column is **IF2 ns / particle / iter**. It falls while the GPU is underused, levels off once the GPU is saturated, and rises if larger batches start to lose efficiency. Each grid point runs in its own subprocess so that peak VRAM is measured per configuration.

## Benchmark Settings & Environment

```{python Settings}
runs = ru.load_timing_data({"pypomp (GPU)": os.path.join("results", "gpu")})
display(HTML(ru.build_settings_comparison_html(runs, is_panel=False)))

csv_path = os.path.join("results", "gpu", "scaling.csv")
has_data = os.path.exists(csv_path)
if has_data:
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)
    if "error" in df.columns and df["error"].notna().any():
        errs = df[df["error"].notna()]
        items = "".join(
            f"<li>{r.scaling_type} J={r.J} chains={r.chains}: <pre>{r.error}</pre></li>"
            for r in errs.itertuples()
        )
        display(HTML(f"<div class='alert alert-warning'><strong>Failed grid points:</strong><ul>{items}</ul></div>"))
    df = df.dropna(subset=["mif_per_iter_seconds"])
    df["Sweep"] = df["scaling_type"].map(
        {"particles": "Varying J (fixed chains)", "chains": "Varying chains (fixed J)"}
    )
    df["ns_per_particle"] = df["mif_per_iter_seconds"] / df["total_particles_mif"] * 1e9
    df["pf_ns_per_particle"] = df["pfilter_warm_seconds"] / df["total_particles_pfilter"] * 1e9
    df_part = df[df["scaling_type"] == "particles"].sort_values("J")
    df_chain = df[df["scaling_type"] == "chains"].sort_values("chains")
else:
    display(HTML(
        "<div class='alert alert-info'><strong>Not run yet:</strong> "
        "<code>python scripts/run_tests.py run tests/spx/scaling/run.py --run-level 4</code></div>"
    ))
```

## 1. Particle Scaling ($J$)

```{python Particle Table}
if has_data:
    display(HTML(scaling.cost_table(df_part, "J").to_html(classes="table table-striped table-hover", index=False)))
```

```{python Particle Plots}
if has_data:
    display(
        ggplot(df_part, aes("J", "mif_per_iter_seconds"))
        + geom_line(color="#1abc9c", size=1.2)
        + geom_point(color="#16a085", size=3)
        + labs(
            title="IF2 time per iteration vs. particle count (J)",
            subtitle=f"{int(df_part['chains'].iloc[0])} chains; warm (compiled) wall-clock",
            x="Particles per chain (J)",
            y="IF2 seconds / iteration",
        )
        + ru.theme_premium
    )
    display(
        ggplot(df_part, aes("J", "pfilter_warm_seconds"))
        + geom_line(color="#3498db", size=1.2)
        + geom_point(color="#2980b9", size=3)
        + labs(
            title="Warm pfilter wall-clock vs. particle count (J)",
            subtitle=f"{int(df_part['chains'].iloc[0])} chains × {int(df_part['reps'].iloc[0])} reps",
            x="Particles per chain (J)",
            y="pfilter seconds (warm)",
        )
        + ru.theme_premium
    )
```

```{python Chain Plots}
if has_data:

        ggplot(df_chain, aes("chains", "mif_per_iter_seconds"))

        + ru.theme_premium

    display(
        ggplot(df_chain, aes("chains", "pfilter_warm_seconds"))
        + geom_line(color="#9b59b6", size=1.2)
        + geom_point(color="#8e44ad", size=3)
        + labs(
            title="Warm pfilter wall-clock vs. number of chains",

            x="Parallel chains",
            y="pfilter seconds (warm)",

        + ru.theme_premium

```

## 3. Where the GPU Saturates

```{python Saturation Plots}
if has_data:
    display(
        ggplot(df, aes("total_particles_mif", "mif_per_iter_seconds", color="Sweep"))
        + geom_line(size=1.2)
        + geom_point(size=3)
        + labs(
            title="IF2 time per iteration vs. particles in flight",
            x="Particles in flight (J × chains)",
            y="IF2 seconds / iteration",
        )
        + ru.theme_premium
    )
    display(
        ggplot(df, aes("total_particles_mif", "ns_per_particle", color="Sweep"))
        + geom_line(size=1.2)
        + geom_point(size=3)
        + scale_x_log10()
        + labs(
            title="IF2 cost per particle per iteration",
            subtitle="Flat region = GPU saturated",
            x="Particles in flight (J × chains)",
            y="ns / particle / iteration",
        )
        + ru.theme_premium
    )
    display(
        ggplot(df, aes("total_particles_pfilter", "pf_ns_per_particle", color="Sweep"))
        + geom_line(size=1.2)
        + geom_point(size=3)
        + scale_x_log10()
        + labs(
            title="Particle filter cost per particle (warm)",
            x="Total pfilter particles (J × chains × reps)",
            y="ns / particle / filter pass",
        )
        + ru.theme_premium
    )
```
